title: Roast Chuck with Roasted Vegetables
description: A hearty and flavorful dish featuring a slow-cooked roast chuck served with a variety of roasted vegetables.
instructions: Season the chuck roast with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the chuck roast until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the roast to a large baking sheet and roast in the preheated oven for 2-1/2 hours, or until tender.
Toss the bell peppers and carrots with olive oil, salt, and black pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
Cook the trofie pasta according to package instructions.
Slice the roast against the grain and serve with the roasted vegetables and pasta.
Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
